title: cyperus sublaevicarinatus
intro: Cyperus sublaevicarinatus, commonly known as the small-crested flatsedge, is a species of sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and infections. The health benefits of Cyperus sublaevicarinatus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and prevent the growth of microorganisms. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and antifungal activities.
